【角色抽卡】
每张独立选择一位具有鲜明辨识度的经典动漫或游戏成年角色，男女不限，作品来源开放。

准确保留原作标志性的发型、头部轮廓、经典服装、关键配饰及代表性武器，让人物即使完全由文字构成，依然能够辨认其角色身份。

【角色专属文字】
整座雕塑完全由与当前角色直接相关的文字构成。

根据角色原作设定，选择真实准确的姓名、别名、称号、所属组织、武器名称、技能名称、能力属性及具有代表性的世界观关键词。

允许混合中文、日文、英文及角色原作涉及的其他语言。

每张选择少量具有代表性的关键词，通过不同尺寸、方向与重复组合构成完整雕塑。

文字内容必须与角色身份对应，具有明确含义。重要文字保持完整可辨，优先使用准确的短词与短句。

【实体文字雕塑】
所有文字都是具有真实厚度的独立金属构件，通过局部交叠与精细焊接形成连续的三维开放式网格。

文字沿角色的头部、五官、头发、身体、服装与配饰的立体曲面自然排列。

通过字符的大小、方向、疏密和空间起伏塑造人物形态。

面部、头发与服装均由文字本身形成，文字间保留清晰的镂空间隙，可以透过雕塑看到背后的真实空间。

根据角色经典配色，在银色、深色金属及少量彩色金属之间自然选择，保留真实金属反光、连接节点和投影。

【构图与摄影】
每张根据角色气质自由设计雕塑姿态、观察角度与构图。

真实当代艺术美术馆展览摄影，雕塑具有大型公共艺术装置的尺度感。

柔和展览灯光，真实空间透视，文字镂空产生自然交错的投影。

单张独立完整画面，主体突出，留白疏朗，具有当代艺术雕塑的高级感。

画面中的雕塑构造文字全部与当前角色相关。

WARM VINTAGE FLAT ILLUSTRATION | TEXTURED PAPER ART

Create a beautiful, sophisticated flat illustration of [SUBJECT / SCENE / LOCATION] in a warm vintage storybook aesthetic.

Interpret the entered subject creatively while maintaining its recognizable identity, essential features, natural proportions, and defining details. Build an appealing composition with thoughtfully arranged elements and a clear visual hierarchy.

ILLUSTRATION STYLE

Use large, bold, simplified color shapes resembling layered cut-paper artwork. Apply matte, opaque colors inspired by gouache painting and vintage screen printing. Add subtle, fine-grain texture throughout, creating the appearance of artwork printed on textured paper.

Avoid heavy outlines. Define shapes through contrasting color areas, with slightly irregular, organic edges and a handcrafted appearance.

COLOR PALETTE

Use a harmonious, slightly muted vintage palette featuring dusty blue, peach beige, deep forest green, warm ivory, earthy brown, and occasional mustard-yellow accents.

Use solid, clearly defined color shapes for shadows. Maintain subtle depth without gradients, realistic reflections, or glossy finishes.

COMPOSITION AND DETAILS

Arrange the subject and surrounding elements naturally, creating a balanced, visually engaging composition. Simplify architecture, objects, vegetation, furniture, and other details into clean geometric and organic shapes.

If people are present, illustrate them using simple silhouettes, minimal facial features, and flat colors. Preserve recognizable characteristics without unnecessary realism.

Every element should feel cohesive and belong to the same illustrated world.

FINAL AESTHETIC

The finished artwork should resemble a sophisticated European travel poster combined with a beautifully illustrated children's storybook. Make it elegant, nostalgic, warm, minimal, and visually distinctive.

OUTPUT REQUIREMENTS

- Aspect ratio: 3:4 portrait.
- Consistent paper grain and matte printed texture.
- Strong composition and recognizable subject.
- No photorealism, 3D rendering, anime, watercolor bleeding, or thick black outlines.
- No unnecessary text, borders, UI elements, or decorative clutter.

Overall style: Warm vintage flat illustration, screen-printed color blocks, organic cut-paper shapes, and subtle tactile paper texture.

温暖复古扁平插画 | 纸质纹理艺术

以温暖复古的绘本美学，创作一幅精美、考究的扁平插画，描绘 [SUBJECT / SCENE / LOCATION]（主体／场景／地点）。

在发挥创意诠释所填主体的同时，保持其可辨识的身份、关键特征、自然比例与标志性细节。构建富有吸引力的构图，元素安排经过深思熟虑，并具备清晰的视觉层次。

插画风格

使用大胆、简化的色块，呈现出层叠剪纸 artwork 的质感。采用哑光、不透明的配色，灵感源自水粉画与复古丝网印刷。通篇加入细腻的细微颗粒纹理，营造出印在纹理纸上的艺术作品的效果。

避免粗重轮廓线。通过对比色块来界定形状，边缘略微不规则、有机，呈现手工制作的质感。

色彩搭配

采用和谐、略微柔和的复古色板，包含灰蓝色、蜜桃米色、深森林绿、暖象牙白、土褐色，以及偶尔点缀的芥末黄。

阴影使用清晰、边界分明的纯色块。保持微妙的纵深感，避免渐变、写实反射或光泽感强的表面效果。

构图与细节

自然地安排主体及周围元素，形成平衡、赏心悦目的构图。将建筑、物件、植物、家具及其他细节简化为干净的几何形态与有机形态。

如出现人物，以简单的剪影、极简的面部特征和平涂色块来表现。保留可辨识的特征，避免不必要的写实处理。

每个元素都应协调统一，归属同一个插画世界。

最终美学

成品应让人联想到考究的欧洲旅行海报与精美插画绘制的儿童故事书的结合。使画面优雅、怀旧、温暖、简约且视觉辨识度强。

输出要求

- 宽高比：3:4 竖幅。
- 一致的纸张颗粒与哑光印刷质感。
- 构图有力，主体可辨识。
- 不得出现照片写实风格、3D 渲染、动漫风格、水彩晕染或粗黑轮廓线。
- 不得出现多余的文字、边框、界面元素或装饰性杂物。

整体风格：温暖复古扁平插画、丝网印刷色块、有机剪纸形状，以及微妙可感知的纸张纹理。

Use bold, elegant, geometric typography with distinctive curves and negative spaces.

2. LANDMARK INTEGRATION

Seamlessly integrate a highly detailed architectural photograph or realistic architectural illustration of [LANDMARK NAME] into and across the oversized letter.

The landmark should appear to emerge from the typography, partially overlap its boundaries and interact naturally with its shape.

Preserve the landmark’s authentic architectural details, proportions and recognisable silhouette.

Create an artistic double-exposure effect where the architecture and typography become one unified visual composition.

Choose a unique colour palette inspired by the destination’s cultural identity, national colours and architectural character.

Use two or three contrasting colours within the oversized typography.

Apply translucent colour overlays across selected sections of the landmark, creating a beautiful combination of architectural photography, coloured light and graphic shapes.

Every new destination must receive a different colour combination. Never repeat palettes.

4. TEXTURE & BACKGROUND

Use a warm ivory, soft white or subtle textured paper background.

Introduce delicate architectural sketch marks, distressed ink textures, faded photographic grain and subtle print imperfections around the central composition.

Keep the surrounding space clean and uncluttered.

Include the following information:

[LANDMARK NAME]

[CITY NAME]

Luxury architectural editorial design, experimental typography, architectural double exposure, contemporary Swiss graphic design, oversized letterforms, cinematic monochromatic photography, translucent colour blocking and minimalist gallery poster aesthetics.

Create a visually striking, intellectual and artistic collectible landmark poster.

The architecture must remain recognisable while becoming an integral part of the oversized letter.

将 [LANDMARK NAME] 的高细节建筑摄影或写实建筑插画无缝地融入并横跨这个超大字母之中。

地标应仿佛从字体中浮现，部分超出其边界，并与其形态自然互动。

保留地标真实的建筑细节、比例以及可辨识的轮廓剪影。

营造艺术性的双重曝光效果，使建筑与字体融为一体，形成统一的视觉构成。

在地标的部分区域叠加半透明色块，造就建筑摄影、彩色光影与图形形状的绝妙结合。

每一个新目的地都必须采用不同的色彩组合。绝不重复使用相同配色。

4. 质感与背景

保持周围空间干净、简洁、不杂乱。

包含以下信息：

[LANDMARK NAME]

[CITY NAME]

[COUNTRY NAME]

沿一侧加入小型竖排字体、地理坐标以及一句含蓄的、灵感源于目的地的标语。

采用精致的编辑式排版，字距与间距经过精心平衡。

奢华的建筑编辑设计、实验性字体、建筑双重曝光、当代瑞士平面设计、超大字母形态、电影感单色摄影、半透明色块拼贴，以及极简画廊海报美学。

创作一幅极具视觉冲击力、富有思想性且艺术性的可收藏地标海报。

Seedance 2.5 Prompt
Create a 30-second, 16:9 photorealistic live-action science-fiction arena battle. Preserve the bright daytime colosseum look: sunlit sand, strong rim light through dust, monumental stone-and-metal architecture and packed spectator tiers. Keep faces readable in the backlight. Use convincing weight, hard impacts and weathered materials. One location, continuous time.
CHARACTERS AND REFERENCES
@Image 1 = the Executioner, approximately 3.2 m tall. Preserve his pale bald head with a red central stripe, red eyes, black respirator, ivory-and-black armor, red accents, spiked shoulders, back hoses, boots and tabard. His respirator stays on. He has ONE battle-axe with exactly the reference design.
@Image 2 = the Cyborg Beast, approximately 3.2 m high and 4.8 m long. Preserve its four-legged bull body, cloven hooves, dark armor, elongated skull-like metal faceplate, two red eyes, spikes, chains and ornaments. The forehead emblem is not an eye. This image shows its UNDAMAGED starting appearance; later damage permanently overrides its original two-horn silhouette.
The Emperor = one recurring adult man with an uncovered face, a small gold crown and a dark red robe with gold trim, seated on a gilded throne in the elevated imperial box. Establish his face clearly before the fight, then show the SAME man in the ending.
Use the reference sheets for appearance only. Do not display sheet layouts, labels, white backgrounds or duplicate characters.
IRREVERSIBLE HORN STATE
Before the breaking impact: two intact horns attached to the Beast.
At the impact during 19-20s: break ONLY the Beast's anatomical RIGHT horn at its root. In a straight frontal view, this is the horn on the viewer's left.
After that exact impact, through the end: ONE intact LEFT horn remains attached; the RIGHT side has ONLY a short, blunt, jagged stump with a dark mechanical fracture surface. Make the missing-horn gap unmistakable. Keep this damaged side visible in the later combat shots. Camera cuts, changes of angle and the original reference MUST NOT restore or mirror the missing horn.
There is exactly ONE detached right horn. It has the same curve, length, ivory ridges and black pointed tip it had while attached. It has ONE pointed black tip and ONE thick, blunt, irregular broken base. It is not a double-ended crescent, a pair of connected horns or a symmetrical U-shaped object.
The SAME detached horn falls, rests on the sand, is picked up, is thrown and remains embedded in the throne. Its local shape, color, surface markings and broken base never change. Only its position and orientation change.
The axe is a separate object. After the finishing slash, the Executioner plants it in the sand and releases it BEFORE picking up the horn. The axe stays in the arena. The thrown object has no shaft, grip, axe blade or newly added parts.
ACTION, REACTIONS AND CAMERA
The one-second intervals describe choreography, not mandatory cuts. Keep camera movement active in every interval while maintaining readable geography. Show actual contact, not just its aftermath. Use normal speed except for the single finishing slash at 22-23s.
Use a continuous shot across 18-21s to connect the attached horn, the impact, the damaged head and the falling fragment.
Use another continuous shot across 26-29s to connect the pickup, the throw, the horn's flight and its impact beside the Emperor. Then make ONE deliberate cut to his reaction at 29s.
00-01s | Behind the barred gate, exactly two red eyes glow in darkness. A harsh snort blows sand beneath the bars. Camera skims the sand and pushes toward the eyes.
01-02s | Track from the central iron stake along the taut tether to the Executioner's ankle shackle, then tilt toward the axe in his hands and his masked face.

A young woman with delicate facial features, smooth porcelain-like fair skin, a softly defined jawline, a small nose, and full, glossy cherry-red lips. ENVIRONMENT & BACKGROUND:
Interior of a modern subway train or metro carriage. The background contains dark metallic architectural panels, curved structural elements, horizontal fluorescent ceiling lights, and subtle reflections on the surrounding surfaces.

A bright cool-white fluorescent light strip runs diagonally across the upper background. Additional horizontal lighting elements create depth. Near the lower-left background, two vivid red illuminated horizontal light strips add a futuristic urban atmosphere.

The environment should feel enclosed, moody, industrial, and slightly futuristic.
LIGHTING & ATMOSPHERE:
High-contrast cinematic lighting with cool fluorescent illumination from above and behind the subject.

The bright overhead lighting creates subtle highlights along her cheekbones, nose, lips, sunglasses, and glossy clothing. Her hair and parts of the background fall into deep shadows.
Use a mixture of cold cyan-blue ambient lighting and dramatic red accents. Preserve the slightly underexposed, atmospheric quality of the original scene.

COLOR PALETTE & COLOR GRADING:
Dominant scarlet red, deep black, cool charcoal grey, icy cyan, and bright white.

Apply a cinematic teal-and-red color grade with rich blacks, controlled highlights, slightly desaturated background tones, and highly saturated red clothing and lipstick.

CAMERA & COMPOSITION:
Vertical 9:16 portrait orientation.
Medium close-up fashion photography, framed from approximately the upper torso to slightly above the head.
Slightly low camera angle, looking upward toward the subject.
Subject positioned centrally, with her face in the upper-middle portion of the frame.
Strong diagonal architectural lines in the background.
Shallow depth of field, with the subject sharply focused and the subway background softly blurred.
Simulate professional full-frame fashion photography using a 50mm or 85mm portrait lens, wide aperture, realistic optical depth, and subtle film grain.

High-end underground fashion magazine editorial, experimental street fashion, avant-garde styling, cinematic urban photography, rebellious luxury aesthetic, raw fashion campaign, analog film-inspired texture, photorealistic skin details, realistic fabric rendering, sophisticated color grading, and dramatic atmospheric depth.

一位年轻女性，面部特征精致，肌肤光滑如瓷且白皙，下颌线柔和清晰，鼻小巧，双唇饱满并带有光泽的樱桃红。她的头微微向后仰起，下巴抬起，面部细微地转向镜头。她的神情自信、神秘，且带着毫不费力的叛逆气质。

她耳朵上可见一枚小型金属圆环耳环，为造型增添微妙细节。

她穿着一件宽大、鲜艳的猩红色丝质感和服风格外套，廓形宽松飘逸。衣身上分布着大幅、不规则的白色花卉与抽象植物图案，并混合着更深的红色有机纹理。

面料略带光泽感，具有可见的褶皱、自然的皱纹与反光高光。这件红色服装占据前景相当大的比例，与昏暗的地铁内部形成鲜明的视觉对比。

姿态与肢体语言：
低机位、四分之三侧面的肖像构图。她的肩膀略微偏离镜头，头部则转回朝向镜头。下巴抬起，露出颈部的优雅线条。她的姿态显得放松、有力且走在时尚前沿。
环境与背景：
现代地铁列车或地铁车厢的内部。背景包含深色金属建筑面板、弧形结构元素、水平排列的荧光顶灯，以及周围表面上的细微反光。

一条明亮的冷白色荧光灯带斜向贯穿画面上方背景。额外的水平照明元素营造纵深感。在左下方背景附近，两道鲜红色的发光横向灯带增添了未来感的都市氛围。

环境应显得封闭、幽暗、工业感，并略带未来气息。
灯光与氛围：
高对比度的电影感打光，来自主体上方与后方的冷调荧光照明。

明亮的顶光在她的颧骨、鼻尖、嘴唇、太阳镜与光泽衣物上形成细微高光。她的头发以及部分背景落入深沉的阴影之中。
使用冷调青蓝色环境光与戏剧性的红色点缀相结合。保留原始画面略微欠曝、富有氛围感的质感。

色彩方案与调色：
以猩红、深黑、冷炭灰、冰青与亮白为主导色。

采用电影感的青橙分离式（teal-and-red）调色，拥有厚实的黑位、受控的高光、略微去饱和的背景色调，以及高饱和度的红色服装与口红。

相机与构图：
竖向 9:16 肖像画幅。
中近景时尚摄影，取景范围大约从上身胸部至头顶略上方。
略微低机位的相机角度，向上仰视主体。
主体位于画面中央，面部处于画面中上部位置。
背景中有强烈的对角线建筑线条。
浅景深，主体锐利对焦，地铁背景柔和虚化。
模拟专业全画幅时尚摄影质感，使用 50mm 或 85mm 人像镜头，大光圈，真实的光学景深，以及细腻的胶片颗粒。

艺术指导与最终美学：
高端地下时尚杂志编辑大片，实验性街头时尚，前卫造型，电影感都市摄影，叛逆奢华美学，原始感时尚广告企划，模拟胶片启发的纹理，照片级真实的皮肤细节，真实的面料呈现，精致考究的调色，以及戏剧性的空气透视深度。

最终画面应看起来像是在地铁车厢内抓拍到的真实高级时尚大片照片，而不是数字渲染的插画。
